CustomField.description: Determines how order lines are split for Power products when quantity is greater than 1. "Order Line Only" shares hardware across split lines (each line gets own cloned partition linked to shared hardware). "Order Line and Hardware" clones hardware for each split line (each line gets own cloned hardware and partition).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select how hardware records should be handled when this product's order lines are split.
CustomField.label: Power Split Type
